objective: Add a doctor command that checks Git, Ollama, the configured local model, Codex CLI, runtime storage, and Viral configuration, then prints a concise health report. Do not change architecture or start a new milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner objective is satisfied: Add a doctor command that checks Git, Ollama, the configured local model, Codex CLI, runtime storage, and Viral configuration, then prints a concise health report. Do not change architecture or start a new milestone.
Repository rules and current approved milestone boundaries are preserved.

notes: Created from the owner-facing viral-dev objective command.
Efficiency selection: WAITING_FOR_MODEL / CODING_HARNESS / HIGH. No authorized coding harness is currently confirmed usable; wait without model usage and probe again before resuming.
Codex Windows shim detection was repaired and live-probed successfully; this objective was not executed as part of the detection fix.
Implemented in the owner-requested Codex task-packet session using harness-default model and MEDIUM effort; deterministic adapter reuse is sufficient for this scoped CLI feature.

Doctor checks all six requested components, isolates failures, excludes raw private diagnostics, supports JSON and nonzero unhealthy exit status, and does not perform inference or launch development work.
All 71 tests, build, typecheck, lint, and M02-M04 acceptance pass. Used direct Node equivalents because pnpm is unavailable and Corepack cannot write its cache in this restricted session.

Live doctor: Git, configured model, storage, and configuration pass; Ollama CLI unavailable and Codex subscription authentication unknown in this restricted environment. Git Credential Manager could not confirm the owner push account.

Git staging blocked by sandbox permission denied creating .git/index.lock; commit and push were not possible. Passing direct-Node verification is preserved in verification/doctor-objective.json; configured pnpm verification failed because pnpm is absent.

Follow-up verification: configured pnpm typecheck, tests (71 passing), lint, and M02-M04 acceptance all pass; direct Node build and equivalent checks also pass. Earlier pnpm absence is resolved in this session. Git publication remained blocked in that coding-harness environment.

Deterministic finalization now runs in the normal Viral owner process with owner identity, origin, development-branch, verification, and push checks. The expanded 76-test suite covers successful publication, push failure, dirty recovery, restart recovery, and idempotency.
Verified implementation committed as 565535880da7e143d9cafd91a2c89baf1916cba7 and pushed to origin/fix/windows-codex-shim-resolution.
